text:
marta: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — capturing remediation owners & timelines for the EU regional outage and routing flaps. I'll run a 30m sync tomorrow to lock down deadlines. TL;DR: multi-region routing rule gaps, intermittent backup verification failures, and restore runbook steps missing for cold restores. Notes: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/eu-routing-2025

alex: +1. Can we add a canary routing test to the recovery checklist? Last time the routing rule diff missed a single tag. :eyes:

sanjay: I can own the routing-rule audit. Will create a small tool to diff active w/ desired routesets and flag missing tags. ETA: EOD Fri (2025-05-23). PR path: infra/tools/route-audit.

rina: I'll take backups verification. Plan: add retention checks + restore smoke test that actually performs a partial restore to a sandbox project (no-prod). ETA: Mon (2025-05-26). Will add run commands and sample outputs to the doc.

sam: I'll pair with @rina for the restore runbook edits — there were ambiguous steps around DNS cutover and cache warming. Also proposing a focused "mini game-day" next Wed 09:30 PT to dry-run the happy path + two failure modes. Who's available?

marta: Agenda for mini game-day: 1) route-audit run + remediation 2) backup restore smoke 3) full restore runbook dry-run (DNS + KV cache warmup) 4) post-checklist owners & SLAs. Please add any missing checks to the doc.

alex: Add step: validate KV-cache warmup latency across regions (script will call endpoint and verify hit-rate). Also add a post-failover traffic-shift sanity check for downstream services.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job: runbook-dryrun created by marta for 2025-06-18T16:30Z (job id rb-dryrun-20250618).

marta: Action items (tracking IDs below, will add to the remediation tracker):
- AI-2025-001: Route-audit tool + remediation doc — owner: sanjay — due: 2025-05-23
- AI-2025-002: Backup smoke + partial restore verification — owner: rina — due: 2025-05-26
- AI-2025-003: Restore runbook rewrite (DNS cutover + cache warmup steps) — owners: sam + rina — due: 2025-06-02
- AI-2025-004: Canary routing test & automated run in CI — owner: alex — due: 2025-06-05

sanjay: I'll drop a short README in infra/tools and add a daily cron to run diff (disabled by default). Planned cron: 
```
0 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/route-audit --env=prod --report=/var/reports/route-diff-$(date +%F).json
```
I'll add an opt-in Slack alert to #incidents for any high-severity mismatches.

rina: For the partial restore smoke I need a sandbox project; @marta can you approve a sandbox quota bump? Also will include a step to validate backup integrity via checksums.

marta: Approved — sandbox quota bump granted for rina/sam until 2025-06-10.

sam: For the mini game-day can we include a short postmortem template to capture recurring patterns (e.g., route-tag drift, backup TTL misconfigs)? I can draft and circulate.

alex: One more ask — add an explicit fallback policy mapping in the runbook (which model/region to fail back to) and a list of owners per fallback target. Saves us time during a roll.

marta: Good call. I'll update the runbook with fallback mapping and owner roster. Please add any owners you know into the tracker.

sanjay: Quick check-in: setting up PR for route-audit today. Will ping when ready for review.

rina: Working on smoke test steps now; will paste a sample restore log into the doc when done.

sam: Mini game-day: tentative Wed 2025-06-18 09:30 PT. If that slot works I'll create a calendar invite and the playbook link.

marta: Thanks all. I'll consolidate AI items into the remediation tracker and send calendar invite for the sync. If anyone finds new recurring patterns, drop them into the doc under "Recurring incident patterns" before the game-day. :+1:
